mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances following a FEDFUNDS decrease.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3% in the same month, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% MoM and UNRATE rises > 0.3% in same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines > 10% MoM and UNRATE rises > 0.3% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows to less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.2% in the same quarter, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1% and UNRATE rises > 0.2% in same quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1% and UNRATE rises > 0.2% in the same quarter.
